segments.title: Built for 2 years. How long did it LAST?
segments.say: NASA built its Swift telescope for two years. How long did it really last? Five, twelve, or twenty two years? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: 22 years!
segments.say: Twenty two years! Eleven times longer than planned.

segments.title: It hunted cosmic explosions
segments.say: It watched thousands of gamma ray bursts, the biggest explosions in the universe.

segments.title: It came down on Nov 4
segments.say: Then its orbit sank, and it fell near Indonesia on November fourth.
Did you guess twenty two? Comment below.
